common.fallback: Button not working? Copy this link into your browser:
invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {organization} as {role}
invitation.headingInternal: You are invited to join {organization} on TManage
invitation.headingClient: You are invited to the {organization} client portal on TManage
invitation.introInternal: You will work with the team at {organization}. Your role: {role}.
invitation.introClient: Follow progress, files and actions shared with {client}. Your role: {role}. You will not see the team’s internal workspace.
invitation.expiry: This invitation expires on {date}. If you were not expecting it, you can ignore this email.
invitation.footer: Sent by TManage on behalf of {organization}
passwordReset.subject: Reset your TManage password
passwordReset.heading: Hi {name}, choose a new password
passwordReset.intro: Someone asked for a link to reset the password of your TManage account. Use the button to choose a new one.
passwordReset.note: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. Changing your password signs you out everywhere.
passwordReset.footer: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays as it is, and nobody can use the link without access to your inbox.
welcome.subject: Welcome to TManage
welcome.heading: Welcome, your workspace is ready
welcome.intro: You created a new workspace and you are its owner. Open it to get started.
welcome.note: This link carries no password and grants no access on its own.
welcome.footer: If you did not create this account, ignore this email or write to support and we will remove it.
emailChange.subject: Your TManage sign-in email changed
emailChange.heading: Hi {name}, your account email changed
emailChange.introOld: TManage support changed the sign-in email of your account. This address no longer signs in.
emailChange.introNew: This address is now the sign-in email of your TManage account. Verify it before you sign in again.
emailChange.note: All your sessions have ended. If you did not expect this change, contact your organization owner or TManage support.
emailChange.footer: This email carries no sign-in link.
securityAck.subject: We received your security report {reference}
securityAck.text:
Thank you. We received your security report, reference {reference}.
The security team will review it and contact you if more information is needed.
If you did not send this report, you can ignore this message.
mfaCode.subject: Your TManage verification code
mfaCode.heading: Hi {name}, here is your code
mfaCode.introSignIn: Use this code to finish signing in to TManage. It confirms it’s you after your password.
mfaCode.introEnrol: Use this code to turn on e-mail codes for two-step verification on your TManage account.
mfaCode.note: The code works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. TManage never asks for it by phone or chat.
mfaCode.footer: If you did not ask for this, someone may know your password: change it in TManage. This email carries no sign-in link.
